definitions.gloss: for gift-giving; as a gift; gift-quality; presentation-grade
definitions.explanation: Describes items that are packaged, graded, or designated specifically for giving as gifts. Implies higher quality presentation and often premium quality.

examples.japanese: {贈答用|ぞうとうよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please put it in a gift box.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{贈答用|ぞうとうよう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{家庭用|かていよう}→家庭用：16544_kateiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This fruit comes in gift-grade and household-grade varieties.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{中元|ちゅうげん}→お中元：06125_ochuugen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{贈答用|ぞうとうよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧⟦フルーツ→フルーツ：11247_furuutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{店頭|てんとう}→店頭：12488_tentou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: When the mid-year gift season arrives, premium fruit for gift-giving lines the shop displays.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{贈答|ぞうとう}→贈答：18041_zoutou⟧ (gift exchange, gift-giving) + ⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧ (for the purpose of). Indicates that an item is intended or suitable for giving as a gift.

USAGE:
Very common in Japanese commerce, where there is a strong distinction between {贈答用|ぞうとうよう} (gift-quality) and ⟦{家庭用|かていよう}→家庭用：16544_kateiyou⟧/{自宅用|じたくよう} (for home use). Gift-quality items feature more attractive packaging, careful selection of individual pieces, and often a higher price. Especially important during gift-giving seasons like ⟦お{中元|ちゅうげん}→お中元：06125_ochuugen⟧ (mid-year gifts) and ⟦お{歳暮|せいぼ}→お歳暮：06126_oseibo⟧ (year-end gifts).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {贈答用|ぞうとうよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{包装|ほうそう}→包装：11932_housou⟧ — gift wrapping
- {贈答用|ぞうとうよう}⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧ — gift set
- {贈答用|ぞうとうよう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{自宅用|じたくよう} — gift-grade and home-use grade
- {贈答用|ぞうとうよう}⟦{菓子|かし}→菓子：00191_kashi⟧ — gift confections

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{贈答品|ぞうとうひん}→贈答品：20125_zoutouhin⟧ — gift item (the item itself, not the designation)
- ⟦プレゼント→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧ — for a present (more casual, Western-style gifts)
- ⟦{進物|しんもつ}→進物：20369_shinmotsu⟧ — formal gift, presentation gift (traditional, formal term)
